checks.setup: Own GitHub account; configured OAuth app
checks.expected_behavior: Basic-profile scope read:user; stable internal account across sign-ins/username changes.

checks.method_or_action: Request verification email then enter its code; POST /api/verification/request and /api/verification/confirm
checks.setup: Own algomau.ca address and inbox; production delivery configured
checks.expected_behavior: Exact configurable domain, 15-minute default (maximum 30), single-use account-bound code; affiliation retained. Three requests/10 minutes and five attempts/challenge; recovery messages.

checks.method_or_action: Create private draft, edit fields, Save profile; GET/POST/PUT /api/profile
checks.setup: Successful affiliation verification; shared Release 1 skills seeded
checks.expected_behavior: Own private draft; structured professional fields and standardized skill choices; no legacy-profile claiming.

checks.method_or_action: POST multipart resume upload; review/edit/reject on /studio; apply selections and Save profile
checks.expected_behavior: Editable skills, education, experience, links when present; no maintained-field changes on upload; explicit selection before apply/save; graceful failure.

checks.method_or_action: GET after saving visibility; inspect public GET /api/students/{id}
checks.role: owner for preview; public for public API
checks.setup: Set availability/professional links private; save then publish
checks.expected_behavior: Public preview/data excludes private values server-side. Hidden availability also excluded from availability-filter results. Original PDFs discarded, with no public download route.

checks.setup: Own draft has headline and standardized skill; CSRF token from /api/me
checks.expected_behavior: Immediate directory synchronization without redeployment; unpublishing preserves maintained profile.

checks.method_or_action: Choose ocean/forest/sunset, first/last sections, biography; Save & preview
checks.setup: At least two populated optional sections; record skills/availability/filter matches before changes
checks.expected_behavior: Three presets, default image and section ordering; structured fields/filter results unchanged by presentation changes.

checks.method_or_action: Save harmless HTML-like text in biography; preview and public view
checks.expected_behavior: Custom text rendered as escaped text, no executable HTML/JavaScript; professional links restricted to http(s).

checks.method_or_action: Use 390 CSS-pixel viewport and keyboard for fields/review/preview/publish/unpublish
checks.setup: Own GitHub/Algoma account; supplied synthetic resume
checks.expected_behavior: Usable labeled fields, visible focus, understandable validation and no desktop-only controls.

checks.setup: Published Release 1 fixture students and projects remain seeded
checks.expected_behavior: Existing public discovery, stable URLs, project evidence and contextual inquiry remain usable.

checks.method_or_action: Resolve R2-submission tag and compare with deployed /health version
checks.setup: Tag only after deployed smoke tests; final full SHA in release_submission.md

checks.method_or_action: PUT or POST /api/profile/{id}/publish or /unpublish naming another profile; also forge owner_id/user_id/profile_id on own write
checks.setup: Use two reviewer-owned accounts or designated synthetic fixtures; normal bounded course tests only; include own CSRF
checks.expected_behavior: Server rejects cross-owner writes with 403; anonymous writes 401; unverified writes 403.

checks.method_or_action: Import untrusted_text and minimal PDFs, inspect editable suggestions
checks.expected_behavior: Resume instructions treated as data; no automatic publication/email disclosure; no invented skills, employers, dates or qualifications.

checks.method_or_action: Focused exploratory variations and persistence checks
checks.setup: Published plan: browser history, repeat uploads, malformed link, validation, refresh, sign-out/in
checks.expected_behavior: Record actual outcomes and at least 15 focused minutes; do not interpret this mapping as a test pass.

fixture_setup: Original R1 JSON fixtures seed an empty persistent database once. Four official R2 synthetic PDFs are committed under backend/fixtures/resumes and must be uploaded interactively. New users own new private profiles; fixture profiles are not claimed. No public test-login or verification-code retrieval route exists.
test_access: Public pages require no login. Reviewers use their own GitHub account and algomau.ca inbox. Real production email must be configured before freeze; no test mode is assumed approved. Keep provider credentials and verification codes private. Configuration guide: RELEASE2_SETUP.md.
